subheading: Search literature, analyze emerging keywords, and track your fields of interest — all in one platform.
noResults: No matching results found for your search query.
featuresDesc: More than just a search engine — an intelligent platform empowering your research productivity.
feature1Desc: Search by keyword, author, journal, or publication year. Results sorted by relevance algorithms.
feature2Desc: Identify emerging keywords, spot maturing topics, and compare multiple keywords on dynamic trend charts.
feature3Desc: Follow your favorite keywords and journals to receive alerts when new articles are published.
feature4Desc: Bookmark key publications, organize research projects, apply tags, and curate reading lists.
feature5Desc: Generate comprehensive trend reports and export data to CSV or PNG formats for academic collaboration.
feature6Desc: Built upon OpenAlex open infrastructure — free access, unlimited queries, and no paywalls.
howToUseDesc: Four simple steps to gain actionable insights into your scientific domain.
step1Desc: Type a research domain or keyword — for example, "Large Language Models" or "Computer Vision".
step2Desc: Instantly view trend trajectories and continuously updated scientific article feeds.
step3Desc: Compare keywords, examine paper metrics, and discover related scientific topics.
step4Desc: Bookmark important papers, monitor target keywords, and stay updated with new publications.
ctaSubheading: Free access, no credit card needed. Start exploring immediately without friction.
footerCredit: Data powered by OpenAlex · Scientific Journal System · FPT University 2025
